analyst.text: Washington have won both meetings this season, including 116-96 on Nov 23, and come in rested after not playing since Tuesday. Orlando are still without Paolo Banchero (high ankle sprain), Jonathan Isaac and Noah Penda, and Kevin Porter Jr. is still reconditioning after signing this week. Anthony Davis (25.6 points, 10.1 rebounds) is playing well despite the trade talk. The news angle leans slightly Washington.
